name: zoo-management-system
description: Full-stack Zoo Management System with Next.js and Express

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['node_modules', 'backend/node_modules', 'frontend/node_modules', 'backend/dist', 'frontend/.next']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
